id.description: Optional stable identifier, so a ClaimTrace can name this build record (execution.binding). Without one, a claim names it as '<platform>:<ref>'.

subject.description: Reference to an ID, optionally pinned to a version (id@vN).

platform.description: Free-form platform name. Recommended values: power_bi, tableau, dbt, metricflow, cube, looker, snowflake, databricks, sql, ossie. Use the same spelling across a repository so bindings can be grouped.

ref.description: Locator inside the platform (measure path, model and metric name, file path).

derived_from.description: The implementation this one was generated from, for hub-and-spoke formats such as Apache Ossie. Lets Assurance tell a hand-built implementation from one produced by a converter.

expression_snapshot.description: The executable logic as it was when conformance_status was last assessed. A tool that can read the platform recomputes the digest and reports drift when it differs.
